notes: Search in your language: type an anime name in Portuguese, English or Japanese and the suggestions show a flag for each language. Pick your language in the welcome tour or in Settings > General (or choose "Original search only" to turn the translated names off).
Optional AniList lookup for anime that are not in the built-in list. It is off by default (About > Privacy) and only sends the name you are typing.
New welcome tour the first time you open the panel, with a language picker. You can replay it from About > Help or Settings > General.

New Report a bug button (About > Help): send a description, photos, videos or the panel log to the Sakugaloader Discord. Nothing is sent until you press Send, and your Windows user name is removed from the log.
The About tab is reorganized into clear cards, and popular multi-word tags such as "one piece" now join correctly when typed with spaces.
SHA256 and ZIP checks, size limits, one update at a time, automatic backup and rollback.
